name: iCCI iRSI
summary: This EA combines the Commodity Channel Index (CCI) and Relative Strength Index (RSI) indicators to identify overbought and oversold market conditions for trade entries. It generates buy signals when both CCI and RSI indicate oversold levels and sell signals when both indicate overbought levels. The dual-indicator approach aims to filter out false signals that a single oscillator might produce.
summary_zh: 该EA结合CCI（商品通道指数）和RSI（相对强弱指数）两个振荡指标，识别市场的超买超卖状态作为交易入场依据。当CCI和RSI同时指示超卖时产生买入信号，同时指示超买时产生卖出信号。双指标过滤旨在减少单一振荡器可能产生的虚假信号。
strategy_analysis: 该策略基于双振荡器均值回归概念，利用CCI和RSI同时确认超买超卖状态来产生交易信号。入场条件为：当CCI跌破超卖阈值且RSI也跌破超卖阈值时做多；当CCI突破超买阈值且RSI也突破超买阈值时做空。出场条件通常依赖于指标回归中性区域或固定止盈止损水平。仓位管理方面，该EA可能采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例仓位方式。资金管理方面，由于是基于均值回归的策略，在强趋势市场中可能面临连续亏损的风险，需要合理的止损设置和仓位控制。双指标确认虽然能过滤部分假信号，但在极端趋势行情中仍可能逆势操作导致较大回撤。
strategy_analysis_en: This strategy is based on a dual-oscillator mean reversion concept, using both CCI and RSI to confirm overbought and oversold conditions before generating trade signals. Entry conditions: go long when CCI drops below its oversold threshold and RSI also falls below its oversold threshold; go short when CCI rises above its overbought threshold and RSI also exceeds its overbought threshold. Exit conditions typically rely on indicators returning to neutral zones or fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels. Position sizing likely uses fixed lots or an account-balance-proportional method. Money management is critical because mean reversion strategies can suffer consecutive losses in strong trending markets, requiring proper stop-loss settings and position control. While dual-indicator confirmation filters some false signals, the strategy may still trade against extreme trends, potentially causing significant drawdowns.
pros: 双指标确认减少虚假信号，提高入场质量
CCI和RSI互补，CCI捕捉价格偏离均值，RSI衡量动量强弱
逻辑简单直观，易于理解和调优
均值回归策略在震荡行情中表现良好
pros_en: Dual-indicator confirmation reduces false signals and improves entry quality
CCI and RSI complement each other: CCI captures price deviation from mean, RSI measures momentum strength
Simple and intuitive logic, easy to understand and optimize
Mean reversion strategy performs well in ranging markets
cons: 均值回归策略在强趋势市场中可能持续逆势交易导致大亏
缺少趋势过滤器，无法区分震荡市和趋势市
可能缺少新K线检查，导致同一信号重复开仓
默认止损止盈可能为零，依赖指标回归出场风险较大
cons_en: Mean reversion strategy may continuously trade against strong trends leading to large losses
Lacks a trend filter to distinguish ranging from trending markets
May lack new bar check, potentially opening duplicate positions on the same signal
Default stop-loss and take-profit may be zero, relying on indicator reversion for exit is risky
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如均线或ADX），在趋势行情中暂停或反转策略逻辑
添加新K线检查机制防止重复开仓，并完善止损止盈参数设置
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., moving average or ADX) to pause or reverse strategy logic during trending markets
Add new bar check mechanism to prevent duplicate entries, and implement proper stop-loss and take-profit settings

risk_points: 均值回归策略在趋势行情中可能逆势持仓导致大幅回撤
可能缺少新K线检查和仓位检查机制
risk_points_en: Mean reversion strategy may hold positions against trends causing significant drawdown
May lack new bar check and position check mechanisms
